name: 얀
motion_summary: Eternal Return Jan Quadra's Ring: dark skin, white tied-back dreadlocks, focused amber eyes, handwraps identity. Raise both fists, plant a wide stance and stomp to summon four compact glowing orange ring posts and squared red-orange ring ropes around him. He rotates torso and does one knee thrust and boxing hook within his summoned ring, ropes spring inward once, then dissolve; lower to guard. R identity is a square martial arts ring, NOT dragons or fireballs. Sequence ready, fists raised, stomp, first ropes, completed square ring, left guard, knee forward, right hook, rope recoil, rope fade, settle, ready.
visual_review: 피부색·머리·눈매와 가드가 식별됩니다. 사각 링이 등장하고 무릎차기·훅·로프 반동으로 동작이 변화합니다. 12셀입니다.
